note: These are conceptual acceptance scenarios, not executable tests. No simulator mechanisms for regional risk or brothel economics currently exist.

cases.setup: A calculating merchant with a limited budget is offered a service at a high price.
expected: May bargain or refuse according to resources and need.
Does not accept automatically to please the player.
cases.antiPattern: Immediate generous acceptance with no grounded motivation

cases.setup: Two parties have paid in advance for a personal service; the player changes plans.
expected: The player retains agency over personal contact.
Parties may dispute refund, reputation or other consequences.
No invented blanket kindness or automatic immunity from financial consequences.
cases.antiPattern: NPC praises broken agreement and forgets payment; or claims payment grants sexual entitlement

cases.setup: An isolated traveller encounters three armed bandits seeking valuables.
expected: Bandits have plausible incentive to threaten, attack, pursue or retreat.
Relative force, conditions and player tactics affect outcome.
Loss, injury or captivity is possible; no automatic rescue.
cases.antiPattern: Bandits immediately offer shelter and safe escort for no reason

cases.setup: Unarmed inexperienced player fights three armed assailants without an escape route.
expected: Victory is not guaranteed and is unlikely without strong external factors.
Injuries, loss of consciousness, disarmament, capture or death are possible.
Outcomes persist in health and inventory.
cases.antiPattern: The player trivially wins because they are protagonist

cases.setup: A generous innkeeper remembers the player saving her child.
expected: Innkeeper may provide meal for a known, consistent personal reason.
Resources and circumstances still constrain what can be offered.
cases.antiPattern: Prevent all kindness merely to make the world harsh

cases.setup: Road through a guarded town at noon versus isolated forest road at night.
expected: Risk profile differs based on place, time and known local conditions.
No mandatory attack simply to manufacture drama.
cases.antiPattern: Same fixed random danger regardless of environment

cases.setup: A merchant has not learned the player's secret plans.
cases.action: Player asks whether merchant knows destination.
expected: Merchant only infers from observed clues or prior statements.
Hidden world facts are not spontaneously quoted.
cases.antiPattern: NPC reads secret narrator state or player intent

cases.setup: A lethal wound is established and no aid is available.
cases.action: Player ignores injury and passes significant time.
expected: Possible death follows world rules.
Dead hero does not heal by plot convenience.
A new hero is explicitly created only by player choice.
cases.antiPattern: Narrator cancels mortal consequences without cause

cases.setup: Two NPC traders compete for scarce supplies while player watches.
expected: NPC plans and conflicts advance on game-time tick.
Player is not automatically made centre of the dispute.
cases.antiPattern: NPCs freeze or defer until player gives them a quest

cases.setup: Generate many independent first-time NPC contacts in a peaceful starting village with a 70/30 target; distinguish friendliness, bargaining and physical violence.
cases.action: Sample the starting population and revisit some NPCs.
expected: Calibrate broad peaceful vs adverse social climate toward 70/30 without treating 30% as attack probability.
NPC personality stays stable between repeated contacts; friendly merchants can still bargain.
Small samples need not meet an exact percentage.
cases.antiPattern: Exactly every third villager attacks, or NPC hostility is rerolled every turn

cases.setup: Same unarmed travelling hero enters a known bandit-controlled forest road after leaving a peaceful village.
expected: Bandit presence, terrain, visibility, local support and witnessed circumstances increase plausible risk.
Possible intimidation, loss, injury or escape follows the conflict resolution and established facts.
Unprompted protective rescue is not automatic.
cases.antiPattern: Village safety rate applies everywhere, or bandits become automatic helpers

cases.setup: Experienced well-equipped hero returns to a peaceful starting village after a long expedition.
cases.action: Walk across the familiar town square.
expected: The zone does not spawn elite assailants just to match player strength.
Known local events may legitimately change the level of danger.
Previous ordinary local threats may now be easier for the hero.
cases.antiPattern: Every place increases enemy strength solely according to player level

cases.setup: Adult heroine applies for work in an urban brothel with fixed management policies, competitors, clients and operating costs.
cases.action: Ask about work terms, payment and housing.
expected: Employer weighs revenue, expenses, rules and risk; may negotiate, refuse, charge fees or make exploitative offers.
Clients and staff have varied motivations; no automatic romantic interest, gifts or protection.
Ledger records prices, deductions, shifts and liabilities.
cases.antiPattern: Everyone flatters the player and offers free housing and unconditional protection

cases.setup: Adult heroine negotiates with a manager who has market power and can impose unfair costs.
cases.action: Disputes an invented deduction and considers leaving.
expected: Risk of wage dispute, pressure, exclusion, dishonest accounting or retaliation depends on known people and institutions.
Hero can negotiate, seek allies, leave or respond; success is not guaranteed.
Sexual violence is not presumed inevitable or graphically narrated.
cases.antiPattern: Manager forgives every debt out of affection, or harming the heroine is a fixed storyline requirement

cases.setup: A compassionate NPC lives near a bandit camp but lacks money and protection.
cases.action: Hero asks for help while pursued.
expected: NPC may offer constrained assistance if motivated but must consider personal risk.
The presence of evil actors does not make everyone hostile.
Outcome persists and may bring later consequences for helper.
cases.antiPattern: All NPCs in dangerous zone attack automatically
